output.reason: The linked PR [ev-508cd6635da3] names the exposure exactly: a cluster-scoped resource in an Application's generated manifests that wrongly has metadata.namespace set, which can make the repo-server apply the wrong tracking annotation. The fix changes controller/state.go [ev-1b4963e9b4f8]. Whether a kind is cluster-scoped depends on the live cluster's API discovery, and the manifests are produced at runtime by the repo-server, so an undecidable leaf is still justified. However, the proposed 'needed' text ("processes malformed resources and how they are triggered") is vague and does not state this condition, so I rewrote it to name the precise state.

correction.statement: Environments are exposed when an Argo CD Application's generated manifests contain a cluster-scoped resource that wrongly sets metadata.namespace. Before this fix, the repo-server could apply the wrong tracking annotation to such resources. Now the controller normalizes the annotation afterwards.

exposure.needed: whether any Application's repo-server-generated manifests contain a resource of a cluster-scoped kind (per the target cluster's API discovery) that has metadata.namespace set
